name: DongWon Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Busan, South Korea, DongWon Development Co.,Ltd. is a construction enterprise founded in 1975. The company, which was originally named Dongwon Housing Co., Ltd. before its rebranding in 1978, boasts a diverse portfolio. Its residential construction division undertakes projects ranging from apartment buildings to towering high-rise complexes. In civil engineering, the firm is responsible for major infrastructure, including highways, bridges, tunnels, subways, railways, and industrial parks. Additionally, DongWon Development specializes in the construction of electric power facilities, factories, logistics warehouses, and seawater desalination plants, leveraging advanced technical manpower across its operations.
